_how_to_use: Add local holidays, festivals, announced transport strikes, road closures and other planned events that can affect an airport. Each event needs a title and a start date (YYYY-MM-DD). The end date is optional. List the airports it affects by their id (for example cebumactan, manilanaia, davao); leave the list empty for an event that affects every airport. impact is reported, possible or awareness; leave it out to let the dashboard decide (possible from the day before, awareness further ahead). kind is a word such as holiday, festival, strike, road closure or event. Events show for the next 7 days and disappear by themselves after their end date. The example below is in the past, so it does not show; copy it to add your own.
